name: Dana Okoro
key_concerns: Hitting the 50% cut in password-reset and order-status tickets within the $500,000 BAC; no surprises at steering
strategy: Weekly 1:1 with the PM; chairs the bi-weekly steering committee; decides escalations within 2 business days; co-presents the M4 pilot launch

name: Priya Nair
key_concerns: Redeployment of 6 FTE of support agents to the complex-case queue (dis-benefit D001); owning a 50% target her team did not set; being bypassed in design
strategy: Co-leads the 3 Support Operations requirements workshops before M1; signs off the benefit baseline (3-month pre-launch ticket volume) by M1; agrees the redeployment plan with HR before cutover; her teams run the M4 pilot first

name: Marcus Webb
key_concerns: Customer credential handling, MFA and session timeout through the identity provider; a sign-off he was not consulted on
strategy: Threat-model review in Discovery (by M1); security sign-off gate before the M4 pilot; consulted before any authentication change such as partner logins (a charter exclusion); fortnightly one-paragraph summary

name: Hana Sato
key_concerns: Data residency of identity and knowledge-base data; accessibility policy (WCAG 2.1 AA, CON-4)
strategy: 30-minute briefing on the portal's data flows in week 3; data-residency sign-off set as a gate before the M4 pilot (due 2026-07-24); consulted before any data-flow change

name: IdentityCo
key_concerns: Margin on the proposed fixed-price services contract (signature planned week 5); requests outside the SOW such as partner logins
strategy: Weekly working session (Ben Adeyemi with IdentityCo's integration engineer); monthly performance review (Sam Lee with the account manager); executive review at M4 and M6 or on escalation (Dana Okoro); escalation path: account manager, then IdentityCo's executive sponsor, then Dana Okoro; linked risk R001

name: Finance
role: Budget holder (releases funds against the $500,000 BAC)
key_concerns: Spend against the $500,000 BAC; cloud hosting overrun (risk R004, owned by Finance)
strategy: Onboarding brief before the M1 baseline approval; monthly cost summary (CPI, SPI, EAC); any forecast above BAC flagged before it reaches steering; consulted before any draw on the $25,000 management reserve

name: Pilot customers
role: Cohort of 200 customers using the portal from M4
key_concerns: Ease of password reset and order lookup; privacy of their data; keeping the phone channel as a fallback
strategy: Invitation and onboarding email 2 weeks before M4; volunteers join the usability rounds; in-portal feedback button; release notes each sprint; survey in week 4 of the pilot

name: Support agents
key_concerns: Job security (6 FTE redeployed to the complex-case queue); a new triage route; extra workload during the pilot
strategy: Priya Nair briefs every team once the redeployment plan is agreed; 20 agents test in UAT (assumption A3); train-the-trainer under WBS 1.5.1; adoption plan through change-management; weekly huddle for questions

name: Order management team
role: Owns the order API behind the order-status feature
key_concerns: Load on the order API; their own change-freeze windows
strategy: API access and a load-test window agreed by week 6; the dependency tracked in the issue log; consulted before every load test

name: Marketing
key_concerns: Launch timing and messaging at GA
strategy: No action beyond the GA launch distribution list; re-rate at M4 when launch planning starts
